summary: Real staging deployment evidence for query-api and Neo4j, including approved image identity, health, functional, persistence, outage/recovery and runtime-hardening checks.
known_limitations: The approval and deployment apply to isolated staging only, not production.
Existing vulnerability findings remain report-only and unresolved.
The health endpoint reports dependency outage as HTTP 500 instead of 503.
No load, failover, backup-restore, long-duration soak or live monitoring dashboard evidence is included.
follow_up_actions: Return HTTP 503 from the health endpoint when Neo4j is unavailable.
Add backup-restore, load and long-duration monitoring evidence before production use.
Continue vulnerability remediation and reassess the deployed images.
